text:
liam: quick follow-up from the eu-prod canary — noticed pinned model metadata doesn't preserve compatibility hints for quantized variants. router picked a non-equivalent fallback and we saw a perf regression :/

anya: can you paste a minimal example? which service picked the wrong fallback?

liam: router-service. example of what we're storing today:
```
{
  "model_id": "redwood/7b-v1",
  "pinned_version": "7b-v1-q4_1",
  "meta": { "note": "quantized variant" }
}
```
The problem: no explicit mapping to the non-quantized parent and no KV-cache compatibility flag. Router guessed and chose a cheaper model that broke latency.

devin: this is the exact downside of the free-form meta approach. we need a typed surface for rollout/pinning metadata — otherwise indexing and router logic become heuristics.

anya: agree on typed fields, but keep it compact. queries on the hot path will read a few columns, not a big blob.

sophie: tradeoff: a rigid schema means migrations when we add fields; untyped meta means silent failures. i'm leaning typed + optional fields.

devin: pragmatic option: add `schema_version` to the pin doc and make new fields optional. router reads fields if present, falls back to old behavior when absent.

liam: sketch proposal for pin document shape:
```
{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "model_id": "redwood/7b-v1",
  "pinned_version": "7b-v1-q4_1",
  "compat_parent": "7b-v1",
  "compat_hints": {"kv_cache": "v2", "kv_compatible": "true"},
  "fallback_chain": ["7b-v1-q4_1","7b-v1-q4_0","7b-v1"],
  "pinned_by": "liam",
  "pin_ts": "2026-03-01T11:22:33Z",
  "lock_reason": "safety-test"
}
```

anya: small rename suggestion: `compat_parent` is clearer than `anchor_version`. also we should mark `fallback_chain` as advisory only.

devin: indexing note: we definitely want `compat_parent` and `pinned_version` as indexed columns for router lookups. `fallback_chain` can be a text/blob column. keep `compat_hints` as JSON but with a constrained set of keys (kv_cache, kv_compatible, seq_len_limits).

osps-bot: deploybot: rollout-metadata-service v0.42 deployed to staging at 2026-03-01T12:34:10Z :rocket:

sophie: decision proposal: adopt schema v1.1 with required keys: `schema_version`, `pinned_version`, optional but recommended `compat_parent`, `compat_hints` (map), `fallback_chain` (list), and `lock_reason`. routers will prefer explicit fields but remain tolerant. backfill job to populate `compat_parent` from historical meta where possible.

liam: i'll write a short RFC + DB migration plan and a compatibility test harness (router unit tests + simulated canary). target PR by EOD Wednesday.

devin: add docs on how to set `compat_hints` — keys: `kv_cache`, `kv_compatible`, `flavor`, `seq_len_max`. we'll validate keys in the API layer.

anya: SGTM. put the RFC in eng/architecture and tag me. I'll review the migration plan.

sophie: thanks all :thumbsup:
